note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. The substituted datum is the supplied configuration of the represented relation: the initial relation (●, Party C's card in her tray) or the intervention requested (◆, her card in the third slot). Both are supplied values of equal weight; the request is never shown as granted or refused; nothing follows from either.
